parameters.name: Auto
parameters.description: Specifies whether to automatically execute the lifecycle management rule.

parameters.name: EnableDeleteTag
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable lifecycle management for the artifact.

parameters.name: RepoName
parameters.description: The name of the image repository.

parameters.name: RetentionTagCount
parameters.description: The number of images that you want to retain.

parameters.name: ScheduleTime
parameters.description: The execution cycle of the lifecycle management rule.

parameters.name: TagRegexp
parameters.description: The regular expression that indicates which image tags you want to retain.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr update-artifact-lifecycle-rule --instance-id cri-r6ym0lerldp0000 --auto false --schedule-time WEEK --namespace-name test-ns --repo-name test_1 --tag-regexp .0production_.0 --retention-tag-count 30 --enable-delete-tag true --rule-id cralr-luq6qiegzvx0000 --scope REPO --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cr UpdateArtifactLifecycleRule --region cn-hangzhou --Auto false --EnableDeleteTag true --NamespaceName 'test-ns' --RetentionTagCount 30 --ScheduleTime WEEK --Scope REPO --InstanceId 'cri-r6ym0lerldp0000' --TagRegexp '.0production_.0' --RuleId 'cralr-luq6qiegzvx0000' --RepoName test_1
